system.implants: Basic Biomods, Basic Mesh Inserts, Chameleon Skin, Cortical Stack, Adrenal Boost, Enhanced Vision, Grip Pads
system.advantages: +10 COO, +5 REF, +5 SOM, +5 WIL, +5 to one other aptitude of the player’s choice
system.description:
Ghosts are partially designed for combat applications, but their primary focus is stealth and infiltration. Their genetic profile encourages speed, agility, and reflexes, and their minds are modified for patience and problem-solving.

Source: Eclipse Phase Morph Recognition Guide, p. 41.
